text:
Alex: Heads-up — HyperLink marketplace listing goes live tonight at 22:00 UTC. Can we finalize the partner SEV path test and war-room flow? Need shared channel + clear handback steps. TL;DR: shared slack channel, pagerduty mapping, war room bridge, runbook pinned, fallback model routing.
Jordan: I can spin up the shared channel and invite HyperLink + SysIntegrate. What oncall rotation do we want for the first 4 hours?
Sophia: I'll own first-response for the first 4h (19:00-23:00 UTC window). Kevin you ok to be tier-2 infra escalation?
Kevin: Yup, I'll be tier-2. Suggest PD escalation policy: 0-5m -> partner-oncall, 5-20m -> infra (me), 20m+ -> eng-sre + partner-liaison. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Creating channel now: #hyperlink-launch-ops. Will invite: HyperLink-ops, SysIntegrate-SI, Alex, Sophia, Kevin.
MarketplaceBot: Channel created: #hyperlink-launch-ops. Invites sent to HyperLink-ops, SysIntegrate-SI.
Alex: Please pin the runbook and the rapid triage checklist. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hyperlink-marketplace-launch.md
Sophia: Pinned checklist and added a short handback template to pinned items. Handback checklist: 1) Confirm partner root cause + RCA owner 2) Confirm fallback served (dedicated->hosted) 3) Confirm tokens/cost tags 4) Re-run smoke tests 5) Create postmortem stub.
Kevin: Adding quick triage commands to the runbook: `kubectl logs -l app=marketplace -n prod --since=30m`, `redis-cli -h cache.prod.redis latency`, `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log`.
Jordan: PD service created: Hyperlink-Marketplace. Escalation snippet: 
``
service: Hyperlink-Marketplace
escalation:
  - after: 5m -> team: hyper-link-oncall
  - after: 20m -> team: eng-sre
```
Sophia: War room bridge created: meet.google/hyperlink-launch. Recording on. War room start 21:45 UTC (30m before go).
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: war room at 21:45 UTC, dry-run at 19:30 UTC. Bridge: meet.google/hyperlink-launch.
Alex: Can we also add a short canned message template for partner-facing comms? A one-paragraph status blurb and next steps.
Jordan: Drafted templates and pushed to https://redwood.internal/templates/hyperlink-launch-templates.md. Short blurb + escalation contacts included.
Sophia: Quick dry-run at 19:30 UTC works for me. I'll simulate a partner-reported latency spike and run through handback. Kevin you in for infra play?
Kevin: In. I'll simulate degraded KV cache and validate fallback path.
Alex: After handback please create incident stub: `/inc create --partner=HyperLink --type=marketplace-launch` and assign postmortem owner.
Jordan: Noted. I'll run the stub and tag product + partner success.
Sophia: SGTM.
Alex: Thanks all — aim to keep the shared channel as single source of truth. If anyone sees gaps in the runbook ping me or update the pinned doc. :rocket:
